summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a joint venture and platform license agreement with Dheer Marketing India to deploy its RedAI infrastructure in India. The JV will be 51% owned by RedCloud and 49% by Dheer Marketing, with a 20-year license commitment valued at $6 million annually (up to $120 million total). There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; the filing describes a standard operational partnership and licensing deal, not a transformative event for shareholders. No premiums, break fees, or advisor recommendations are mentioned. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer.
